faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How much does it cost to build a mobile app?
faq.a1: Simple apps with 5-10 screens typically cost €5,000–€15,000. More complex apps with custom backends, payments, or real-time features range from €15,000–€50,000+. We always provide a fixed-price quote after the discovery phase.
faq.q2: How long does mobile app development take?
faq.a2: An MVP (Minimum Viable Product) typically takes 8–16 weeks. Full-featured apps with complex backends can take 4–6 months. We'll give you a realistic timeline upfront.
faq.q3: Should I build for iOS, Android, or both?
faq.a3: For most businesses, we recommend starting cross-platform with React Native or Flutter — you get both platforms at roughly 60% of the cost of building natively twice. If your audience is predominantly iOS or Android, we can go native for maximum performance.
faq.q4: Do you handle App Store and Google Play submissions?
faq.a4: Yes, completely. We set up developer accounts if needed, prepare all store metadata, screenshots, and privacy policies, submit the app, and manage the review process until approval.
